primer.summary: Almost all the electricity a data center uses ends up as heat, so cooling is the second-largest power user and a cooling failure takes the site down. Think of a cold-storage warehouse where the product is servers.

notes.text: NVIDIA's GB200 NVL72 is a liquid-cooled rack at 120 kW; CBRE says 100 kW GPU servers can only be cooled by closed-loop liquid cooling.

Ammonia is rare in U.S. data centers, so the refrigerant line, not the ammonia line, is the relevant one.

note.title: Ethylene oxide rules are being relaxed
note.text: In July 2025 the administration exempted 41 facilities from EPA's 2024 sterilizer rule, and in March 2026 EPA proposed letting sterilizers choose continuous or parametric monitoring. Workplace exposure limits still apply, which is why this page does not lead with ethylene oxide.
